items.title: 12.9 Universe (kaainat) mein matter aur antimatter ki asymmetry (barabar na hona) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.9 (PDF 274) in the book's order, with a note and a self-check.

blocks.text: Bohat si observations (mushahidat) batati hain ke universe mein matter aur antimatter barabar nahi (isay asymmetry kehte hain); yeh hamare universe ki sab se hairan kun baaton mein se hai. Kai hypotheses (andaze jo abhi prove nahi hue) hain jo dikhate hain ke universe taqreeban poora matter se bana hai, antimatter se nahi. Maslan kitab ke mutabiq universe ka taqreeban 5% ordinary (aam) matter (electrons, protons, neutrons) hai, aur is aam matter mein taqreeban 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium hai; universe mein antihydrogen ya antihelium atoms ka koi hissa nahi milta.

Kitab likhti hai ke experiments ke results batate hain ke yeh asymmetry baryon number ki conservation toot jane (violation) ki wajah se hai, yani baryons aur anti-baryons ki tadaad barabar nahi rahi. Agar particle-antiparticle symmetry bhi toote to aisa mechanism (tareeqa) ban sakta hai jo antiquarks se zyada quarks, antileptons se zyada leptons aur aakhir mein antimatter se zyada matter banaye. Is liye result yeh hai ke matter aur antimatter ki asymmetry ka masla abhi tak mystery (raaz) hai. (Note: baryon number ka tootna abhi tak kisi experiment mein nahi dekha gaya; yeh ek hypothesis hai.)

blocks.title: Ek unsolved (abhi tak hal na hua) masla
blocks.text: Universe mein taqreeban koi antimatter kyun nahi, yeh physics ke bare unsolved sawalon mein se hai; upar ki explanations hypotheses (andaze) hain, proved (sabit shuda) results nahi.

blocks.prompt: Reasons (wajahein) bataiye ke hamara universe taqreeban poora matter se kyun bana hai (comprehensive question 12.3). Matter aur antimatter ki asymmetry kin particles ki tadaad ke imbalance (barabar na hone) se hai (MCQ 12.16)?
blocks.explanation: Agar Big Bang ke baad matter aur antimatter bilkul barabar bante to aapas mein annihilate ho kar (mil kar khatam ho kar) radiation ban jate; jo matter hum dekhte hain woh batata hai ke matter thora sa zyada tha jo bach gaya. Proposed (pesh ki gayi) wajahein aise processes hain jo baryon number conserve nahi rakhte aur particles aur antiparticles ke saath thora alag behave karte hain, taa ke antiquarks se zyada quarks aur antileptons se zyada leptons banein; asal wajah abhi tak mystery hai. MCQ 12.16: (c), baryons.

items: Universe taqreeban poora matter hai: antihydrogen ya antihelium nahi milta (kitab: aam matter taqreeban 5%, us mein 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium).
Possible (mumkin) wajah: baryon number aur particle-antiparticle symmetry ka tootna; masla abhi tak hal nahi hua.
